description: This file defines classes for formatting and reporting tag usage and locations in the Behave testing framework, including AbstractTagsFormatter, TagsFormatter, and TagsLocationFormatter.

classes.name: AbstractTagsFormatter
classes.description: Base class for formatters that collect tag information.

classes.name: TagsFormatter
classes.description: Formatter that collects and reports tag counts and usage frequency.

classes.name: TagsLocationFormatter
classes.description: Formatter that reports tags and their usage locations.

methods.name: uri
methods.description: Sets the URI for the current feature or scenario.

methods.name: scenario
methods.description: Records tags from a scenario, optionally including feature tags.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Emits tag count reports and closes the formatter.

methods.name: record_tags
methods.description: Records tags associated with a model element.

methods.name: report_tags
methods.description: Abstract method to generate report; implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: report_tag_counts
methods.description: Reports the counts of each tag.

methods.name: report_tag_counts_by_usage
methods.description: Reports tags ordered by usage frequency.

methods.name: get_tag_count_details
methods.description: Provides detailed info about a tag's usage categories.

methods.name: report_tags_by_locations
methods.description: Reports tags along with their usage locations.
